body: The Dental Tourism Field Guide is the book you wish you had at the kitchen table the night a quote made your stomach drop — a calm, practical manual for the cost-shocked patient considering dental work abroad.

It is not a ranking of countries, clinics, or destinations. It teaches you to vet a clinic before you deposit, decode a quote the way an organized buyer would, recognize sales pressure, compare proposals fairly, and know what to do when something goes wrong.

Built around the Five Rules, the Seven Leverage Points, and a 20-Minute Safety Pause — with 12 scenarios, word-for-word scripts, green/yellow/red checklists, and 15 reusable worksheets. Re-researched and updated every year.
